text: Men nuliraali Nulaaɗo woo, si wanaa e haala yimɓe makko ɓen, fii no ɓe faamira ko o addi kon immorde ka Alla. Men nuliraali mo doolugol yimɓe ɓen e gomɗingol Alla. Alla hino majjinira nunɗal Makko ngal on Mo O muuyi, O fewnira ɓural Makko ngal on Mo o muuyi. Ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun e toppitagol Mun.
